verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents natural-language operation in several forms: the Video Agent creates videos from a text prompt (heygen-docs-10), takes follow-up messages to iterate on storyboards (heygen-docs-12), and revises only the scenes you name (heygen-docs-11). It also offers Slack prompting (heygen-docs-15), and an official MCP server, confirmed by probe, lets Claude, Cursor or other agents drive every endpoint without glue code (heygen-docs-4, heygen-docs-7, heygen-probe-3). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language control works as claimed, and in-depth docs showing it covers non-video operations such as account or asset management, beyond marketing-level snippets.
